bubbles.text: I came straight from the garden. I'm covered in mud. Can I even pray like this?
Is there any najasa on your clothes? Anything impure?
No... just mud. And sweat. Lots of sweat.
Dirty and impure aren't the same. In fiqh, "pure" is a legal word.
Mud makes you dirty. Najasa makes you impure.
So I could fall in a mudslide and still be pure?
Yes! But if your wudu broke, you still need wudu. That's the other kind: ritual impurity.
So I can be spotless and still not ready to pray?
Exactly. Taharah means removing najasa from your body, clothes and place of prayer, and being in wudu.
Okay. Wudu first... then I'm changing out of these!
